# Kingshot Toolbox

> Free calculators, planners and reference databases for the mobile strategy game Kingshot. Bilingual EN/FR, no account and no sign-up: everything a player enters stays in their own browser.

Kingshot Toolbox is a static site covering three needs: optimizers that answer "what should I do next" (research order, TrueGold upgrades, troop splits), databases that answer "what does this cost" (buildings, researches, masters, pets), and shop pages that answer "is this a good deal" (in-game cost compared to gem value and to real money).

Every page is available in English and French; the served HTML is English and the French is applied in the browser. One page also has a real French address of its own: the Theater Shop, served as French HTML under /fr/. Player data is stored locally and is never sent anywhere.

## Tools

- [Research](https://kingshottoolbox.com/research_calc): pick the order of your scientific researches and track progress across the Growth, Economy and Battle trees.
- [TrueGold](https://kingshottoolbox.com/truegold_calc): plan TrueGold building upgrades and work out the resources and speedups needed.
- [War Academy](https://kingshottoolbox.com/waracademy): plan TrueGold troop research, with the optimal path to maximise researches, KvK points, or reach a target score.
- [Bear Trap](https://kingshottoolbox.com/beartrap_calc): build rally marches from your own heroes and troops and get a deployment plan for the event.
- [Vikings](https://kingshottoolbox.com/vikings): split your troops across marches for the Vikings event to maximise defence.
- [Heroes](https://kingshottoolbox.com/caserne): manage your heroes, their generations, skill levels and exclusive gear.
- [Masters](https://kingshottoolbox.com/masters): browse experts, their skills and affinity milestones to optimise bonuses.
- [Pets](https://kingshottoolbox.com/pets): browse your pets tier by tier - attributes, level, army bonus and skills.

## Databases

- [Buildings](https://kingshottoolbox.com/database/buildings/): every building's full upgrade table - TrueGold, Tempered TrueGold, resources, build time and requirements per level.
- [War Academy Research](https://kingshottoolbox.com/database/waracademy/): every troop research level by level - TrueGold dust, resources, time, effects and requirements for the Infantry, Archer and Cavalry trees.
- [Masters DB](https://kingshottoolbox.com/database/masters/): each expert's affinity milestones, passive expertise, and every skill's effect, EXP cost, manuscripts and power per level.
- [Pets DB](https://kingshottoolbox.com/database/pets/): each pet's skill effect per tier, advancement costs and Pet Food required for every level.

## Shop value

- [Shop Value](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop_calc): index of every shop, grouped into event shops, permanent shops and custom chests.
- [Item values](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/items): the gem-value reference used to price every shop item.
- [Real-money item values](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/items-euro): the observed price of items in euros and dollars, with the pack each figure comes from.

Event shops: [Theater Shop](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/theater-shop) (also in French at [/fr/shop/theater-shop](https://kingshottoolbox.com/fr/shop/theater-shop)), [Blizzard Shop](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/blizzard-shop), [Dragon's Caravan](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/dragons-caravan), [Adventure Stall](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/adventure-stall), [Polar Shop](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/polar-shop), [Summit Contest Champion](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/summit-contest-champion), [Summit Contest Ordinary](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/summit-contest-ordinary), [Flamedragon Tyrant Prediction](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/flamedragon-tyrant-prediction), [Golden Ball](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/golden-ball-shop) (event over, page kept as an archive).

Permanent shops: [Arena](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/arena), [Alliance Championship](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/alliance-championship), [Swordland](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/swordland), [Kingdom of Power](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/kingdom-of-power), [Tidal Shop](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/tidal-shop), [Trial Shop](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/trial-shop).

Custom chests: [Gear Boost](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/gear-boost-chest), [War Chant](https://kingshottoolbox.com/shop/war-chant-chest).
